answer: Barrels do not lie. Tap one and you hear whether the staves were planed true. Proof of cooper barrel via stave hoop log — a barrel the cooper binds only after 27 staves run true, each stave planed by the cooper himself. The reef soaks the oak till it bends without splitting. The timber holds the hoops the cooper drives down. The summit stores the finished casks till the wagons come. A forger must plane 27 staves true, hoop 27 staves and prove 27 staves, three days in the yard for a barrel that still weeps at the seam.
